<title level="1" pfs="Standard">[Aiuvarin Elementalist](/NPCs.aspx?ID=2996)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

Commonly referred to as half-elves, aiuvarins often have trouble fitting into society. This can lead to many aiuvarins diverting their full attention towards their own personal pursuits, such as studying spellcasting.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Humanoid](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=47)): DC 16

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 14

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 11
</column>

</column>

<column gap="medium">

</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature 2">[Aiuvarin Elementalist](/NPCs.aspx?ID=2996)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Medium" />
<trait label="Aiuvarin" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=515" />
<trait label="Elf" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=588" />
<trait label="Human" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=627" />
<trait label="Humanoid" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=628" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 151

**Perception** +11; [low-light vision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=69)

**Languages**
[Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Elven](/Languages.aspx?ID=4)

**Skills**
[Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +7, [Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2) +8, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +5, [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) +4, [Elemental Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) +8, [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10) +6, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +7

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +1

**Dex** +3

**Con** +0

**Int** +4

**Wis** +2

**Cha** +0
</row>

**Items**
[Dagger](/Weapons.aspx?ID=3)

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 17 

**Fort** +5 

**Ref** +11 

**Will** +8 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 20

</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 30 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
dagger +9 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179), [versatile S](/Traits.aspx?ID=200)),
**Damage** 1d4+3 piercing

**Ranged**
<actions string="Single Action" />
dagger +9 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [thrown 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=195), [versatile S](/Traits.aspx?ID=200)),
**Damage** 1d4+3 piercing

**Arcane Prepared Spells** DC 18
- **Cantrips (1st)**
[Detect Magic](/Spells.aspx?ID=66), [Electric Arc](/Spells.aspx?ID=97), [Light](/Spells.aspx?ID=171), [Message](/Spells.aspx?ID=190), [Shield](/Spells.aspx?ID=280)
- **1st**
[Gentle Landing](/Spells.aspx?ID=1542), [Gust of Wind](/Spells.aspx?ID=143), [Illusory Disguise](/Spells.aspx?ID=159), [Thunderstrike](/Spells.aspx?ID=1721)

**Elf Step** <actions string="Single Action" />  The elementalist Steps twice.

**Elemental Field** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([Arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=11), [Concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [Electricity](/Traits.aspx?ID=56)) The elementalist unleashes powerful static electricity in a 20-foot emanation that lasts for 1 minute. All squares in the area become [hazardous terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=454) for other creatures. A creature takes 1 electricity damage each time it moves into one of these squares. While in the area, creatures take a –1 status penalty to saves against [electricity](/Traits.aspx?ID=586) spells.

</column>
